### 1 — Scene
A cooked meal that appears to contain a sausage, roasted potato pieces, broccoli and other vegetables, with a reddish sauce. Exact ingredients are uncertain.

### 2 — Vessel
A dinner plate, estimated at **26 cm diameter**.  
Plate area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
- One sausage on the left
- Golden potato pieces
- Broccoli and mixed vegetables, including apparent carrot/tomato pieces
- Reddish sauce with a slight oily sheen

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
The food occupies approximately **55% of the plate**. Area allocations below avoid counting the same footprint twice; heights approximate the respective portions.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Sausage | 8% | 42.5 cm² × 2 cm = 85 ml | 0.95 | 81 g | 250 | 203 kcal |
| Roasted potatoes | 24% | 127.4 cm² × 2.2 cm = 280 ml | 0.65 | 182 g | 150 | 273 kcal |
| Broccoli and mixed vegetables | 17% | 90.3 cm² × 2 cm = 181 ml | 0.60 | 108 g | 40 | 43 kcal |
| Reddish sauce | 6% | 31.9 cm² × 0.8 cm = 26 ml | 1.0 | 26 g | 80 | 21 kcal |
| **Total** | **55%** | | | **397 g** | | **540 kcal** |

The potato and sauce energy estimates include modest visible cooking fat; no additional unseen oil is assumed.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **400 g and 540 kcal** is plausible for the visible sausage and moderately piled potatoes and vegetables on a partly uncovered dinner plate. The largest uncertainty is the identity and oil content of the golden pieces and sauce.
